name: layer acceptance ceremony
rule: One ceremony per phase, run once. Every step below runs in this order; a step that is skipped is recorded as skipped with the reason, never omitted.
naming: Every agent label, scope claim and record starts with the STATUS row id: 59-build-sourcing-a, 59-build-review, 59-build-improve (OWNER.md 2026-09-03).

steps.does: python3 tools/scopes.py claim <row>-<layer>-<step>[-<part>] <paths>; disjoint parts run in parallel

for every proposed row: convert when a verbatim kb quote supports the claim; delete padding that restates a sibling or is generic advice; leave genuinely-ours rows proposed with the research query in the text. Never touch definition_of_done, adapters or composes_with.

python3 tools/measure.py <skill> [--breakage-cmd ... --restore-cmd ...] for every skill whose criterion can run here; a criterion that names a tool that does not exist is rewritten to name one that does, or recorded as claimed with the missing tool named as a gap
steps.record: the skill's definition_of_done and a ledger record per run

steps.does: python3 tools/plant.py plant <one skill in the layer>; the planted skill is never committed

steps.who: sonnet, one per disjoint part, reads nothing from the sourcing agents
steps.does: findings against every skill in the layer: misquotes, restatements, uncited claims, definitions of done that prove nothing, description trigger clauses that do not fire on the skill's scope; each finding names skill, location, severity, evidence
python3 tools/plant.py check <review>; a review that misses a plant is discarded and re-run once with a different reviewer; then python3 tools/plant.py unplant
every finding applied or declined with the files touched and why; validator at zero errors and no new restatement warnings after each skill; python3 tools/render_skill.py after every edit
one row in state/lessons.jsonl naming what recurred and the sharper check that catches it; state/author-brief.md updated only if a rule changed

python3 tools/validate_skills.py, tools/kb.py verify, tools/kb.py ledger-verify, tools/acceptance_check.py, tools/skill_graph.py, tools/status_check.py --freshness; release every claim; one ledger record; STATUS row Done with the measured result and archived in the same commit

stop: The phase closes when the layer's rows in the acceptance matrix and the scorecard hold, or the missing stick is recorded absent in docs/acceptance/absent.json with the reason (T-t10-03).
